title: Recommendations for parameter definitions and letter symbols for hydraulic fluid power pumps, motors and integral transmissions
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11147) covers Recommendations for parameter definitions and letter symbols for hydraulic fluid power pumps, motors and integral transmissions. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 4391-1983 * Hydraulic fluid power — Pumps, motors and integral transmissions -- Parameter definitions and letter symbols ', issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on the recommendations of the Fluid Power Systems and Components Sectional Committee and approved by the Mechanical Engineering Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology, conventions and method of presentation may be different from those normally used in the Indian Standard. Wherever the words ' International Standard ' appear referring to this standard, they shall be read as * Indian Standard '. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
